messages.subject: wrds package - GSOC'15
parts:
Hi Everyone, 

I am Rishabh, a GSOC 2015 Student Participant from India. I've been a GSOC intern for year 2014; I worked with Mifos Initiative during that period.

I had a look at 'wrds package' project, and I found it quite interesting and a necessary one, to work with available data at 'CRSP' in R as well. I also had a look at this python repo https://github.com/edwinhu/wrds which is trying to achieve a similar objective in Python. Although the potential tests are not yet listed on wiki page of 'wrds package' project, I think I'll start with creating a simple function to download and store a small CCM dataset for now.

Or if Guy Yollin has already decided on some other potential tests then may be I can start with that, right away.

Thanks,
Rishabh
CSE Undergraduate
SMVDU, Jammu
India
